mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_chunk (content, embedding, metadata, user_id) VALUES ( #{content}, #{embedding, typeHandler=com.example.langchain4j.repository.typehandler.VectorTypeHandler}::vector, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), #{userId} )

INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_chunk (content, embedding, metadata, user_id) VALUES
( #{chunk.content}, #{chunk.embedding, typeHandler=com.example.langchain4j.repository.typehandler.VectorTypeHandler}::vector, CAST(#{chunk.metadata} AS jsonb), #{chunk.userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, content, embedding, metadata::text AS metadata, user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_knowledge_chunk WHERE id = #{id} AND (user_id IS NULL OR user_id = #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_chunk SET content = #{content}, embedding = #{embedding, typeHandler=com.example.langchain4j.repository.typehandler.VectorTypeHandler}::vector, metadata = CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS total_chunks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL) AS private_chunks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE user_id IS NULL) AS public_chunks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE content IS NULL OR length(trim(content)) = 0) AS empty_content, count(*) FILTER (WHERE embedding IS NULL) AS no_embedding, COALESCE(AVG(length(content)), 0) AS avg_content_length, MAX(created_at) AS last_imported_at FROM ai_knowledge_chunk WHERE user_id IS NULL OR user_id = #{userId}
